name: JUNGLE-TRAILS-the-block-s-floor-without-the-half-width
why: The block's floor is a worst-case bound (the noise's steepest through the warp's stretch, less the block's half diagonal) and stands at least 4.85 tiles under a point's true distance - over 800,000 points of 40 pixels the half width (0.75) never decided the shortcut, so no pin can tell the two apart. It is kept because the shortcut is exact only with it: a floor that came within the half width of a trail would otherwise call a tree's foot clear of the dirt it stands on.
